messages.content: The disclosure anchor: at 9 am the day before it reads the latest 60-day disclosure (the aggregate offer and bid curves of D-61 and D-62), shifts them by the as-issued load, wind and solar forecasts, best-responds to its own price impact and self-schedules the quantities. On the operating day it re-plans the open hours on the awards' prices and a decaying real-time basis.
